intent.goal: Detect genuinely problematic json dash tags in Go structs, avoid flagging intentional exclusions, and provide precise actionable findings.
intent.acceptance: A source-bound downstream actual-parent transition restores an explicitly required JSON field previously excluded by a dash tag. Require independent expected serialized bytes or consumer field requirement in retained source, and native standard-library encoding/json evaluation of a locally authored bounded fixture representing the exact field/tag/type. Tag removal alone is not improvement.
